{{Quote|You and the ''Admonitor'' will be heading back to the Chaos Triangle to begin cleaning up the legacy that Nuso Esva left behind.|Grand Admiral Thrawn, to Senior Captain Voss Parck|<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />}}
The '''Chaos Triangle''' was a location.<ref name="Crisis of Faith">{{StoryCite|story=Crisis of Faith|book=Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition}}</ref> In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">The events of ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'' take place in [[8 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> after the [[Death/Legends|death]] of the [[Storm-hair]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] during a [[Attack on the Red City|battle]] between his forces and the [[Empire of the Hand]] on the<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]<ref name="Atlas Appendix">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Quethold system/Legends|Quethold system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]], Imperial [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] [[Commanding officer/Legends|ordered]] [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Senior Captain]] [[Voss Parck/Legends|Voss Parck]] to travel with the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Admonitor]]'' to the Chaos Triangle, where Parck would begin cleaning up what the Grand Admiral referred to as Esva's "legacy."<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Chaos Triangle was mentioned in the novella ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]] and published in [[2011]] as part of the [[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition|20th Anniversary Edition]] of the [[1991]] novel ''[[Heir to the Empire]]''.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />
